status_summary: VA announced on 2025-02-03 that it would end most telework and remote work agreements in phases, beginning with political appointees, senior executives and equivalents and nearby supervisors by 2025-02-24, then non-bargaining employees within 50 miles of an agency facility by 2025-04-28, with exceptions for disability, medical conditions and military spouses. On 2025-02-24 VA reported that employees nationwide had returned to in-person work and that all personnel were expected on site by July 2025. A later schedule reported by Federal News Network gave 2025-05-05 and 2025-07-28 for other groups. The policy followed a presidential memorandum on return to in-person work dated 2025-01-20.

timeline.event: Presidential memorandum on return to in-person work for federal employees, published in the Federal Register on 2025-01-28.

VA announced that telework and remote work agreements would end by 2025-02-24 for political appointees, senior executives and equivalents and supervisors within 50 miles of an agency facility, and by 2025-04-28 for non-bargaining employees within 50 miles, with bargaining-unit dates to follow and exceptions for disability, medical conditions and military spouses.
VA's first telework end date took effect; the Secretary welcomed employees back to in-person work nationwide, and VA said all personnel were expected on site by July 2025.

title: Review hybrid and remote work at VA headquarters and favor in-person presence

The Federal News Network memo schedule (2025-05-05, 2025-07-28) carries no printed memo date and differs from VA's release (2025-04-28 for non-bargaining employees); the later dates are not used in the timeline.
